new_cards.claim: GDT717 gives otchy, otchey, otchdy, okchedy and otshey portable quality/stage cores while keeping Zubereitung only in their local realizations. Otchy/otchey/otchdy distinguish cold-dry beginning, middle and reached beginning; okchedy is hot-dry reached middle and otshey cold-moist open middle. Unlike GDT647’s initial-o preparation distinction, this five-form revision excludes the preparation noun from lexical content. It does not revise all 107 older grid forms or establish free state/stage morphemes.

GDT717 assigns chody the complete-word core leicht getrocknet; abgeschlossen. Only its licensed local realization reads leicht getrocknete Zubereitung; abgeschlossen. The light-drying content remains a wholeform proposal; its visible dy is not formal DY and gives no free completion/stage rule. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT717 assigns sheody the complete-word core feucht angesetzt; Anfangsstufe abgeschlossen. Only its licensed local realization reads feucht angesetzte Zubereitung; Anfangsstufe abgeschlossen. The core still says feucht angesetzt; removing the product noun does not erase that state/process content. Visible dy is not formal DY. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT718 assigns oteed the complete-word core vollständig abgekühlt; abgezogen. Only its licensed local realization reads vollständig abgekühlter und abgezogener Auszug. The table retains abgezogen in the core; Auszug is replaceable local content. No common written withdrawal family or free eed/d rule is licensed. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT718 assigns keeod the complete-word core vollständig erhitzt; abgezogen. Only its licensed local realization reads vollständig erhitzter und abgezogener Auszug. The table retains abgezogen in the core; Auszug stays local. The same German withdrawal/result domain does not establish a shared written stem. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT718 assigns kchod the complete-word core heiß-trocken; abgeschlossen. Only its licensed local realization reads heißer Auszug aus Trockengut, abgezogen und abgeschlossen. Unlike oteed/keeod, this core omits Abgezogen as well as Auszug and Trockengut; those remain only in its local product rendering. No shared withdrawal morphology follows. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT719 assigns kchody the complete-word core heiß-trocken; abgeschlossen. Only its licensed local realization reads fertige heiß-trockene Zubereitung. The preparation noun is local only; the three-word source comparison rejects a common free DY decomposition and does not identify a product. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT719 assigns ochdy the complete-word core trocken; abgeschlossen. Only its licensed local realization reads fertige Trockenmasse. Trockenmasse is a replaceable local head, not part of this portable state core. No free DY or other internal component is established. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT719 assigns oechedy the complete-word core bis Mittelstufe getrocknet; abgeschlossen. Only its licensed local realization reads fertige, bis zur Mittelstufe getrocknete Masse. The mass/preparation head is local; the source does not license shared DY decomposition or a free stage/closure meaning from this learned whole. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT722 assigns opchedaiin the complete-word core drei Portionen bis zur Mittelstufe getrockneten Pulvers. Its local realization uses the same wording. The older Dosen and Pulveransatz reading is not identical: the source chooses neutral portions and removes an extra preparation head at P043. The stated three remains a working wholeform value, not a confirmed number or medical dose. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT722 assigns chopo the complete-word core Pulverzubereitung aus Trockengut. Its local realization uses the same wording. The older aus Trockenansatz reading keeps a different input head. Mixture versus preparation remains open; the second O has no independently identified function under CH+O+P+O. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT722 assigns qopaiin the complete-word core drei Teile Pulverzubereitung. Only its licensed local realization reads drei Teile der Pulverzubereitung nehmen. Nehmen is licensed only at local P158, not in the portable core of every qopaiin. Preserve the older action-bearing reading and do not infer free internal p/op meanings. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT722 assigns opchey the complete-word core Trockenpulver, Form I. Its local realization uses the same wording. The older Trockenpulveransatz head is removed. The recurring opch<E>y form pattern does not independently identify powder, dry state or form-I component values. This remains an unconfirmed historical wholeform hypothesis.

GDT722 preserves concrete powder/state/portion meanings for opchedaiin, chopo, op, qopaiin and opchey as bound complete-word defaults, while learned whole versus unexported internal composition stays unresolved. Only qopaiin at P158 receives local nehmen outside its nominal core. Initial-p powder evidence is not exported to their internal p; chopo’s second O lacks an independently licensed function. The opchey/opcheey recurrence is formal evidence only. This is a five-whole scope policy and local rendering map, not a productive OP dictionary or five independently confirmed meanings.
